topPick.thesis: Allstate (ALL) is trading at 5.1x P/E, a 66% discount to its sector average of 15.3x; RSI at 42 indicates recovering momentum from recent lows. Three-month price momentum of +15.4% reflects exceptional institutional accumulation, with EPS growing +61% year-on-year, underpinned by a bearish MACD signal suggesting near-term caution is warranted. Composite score of 78/100 places ALL in the top 1% of S&P 500 constituents across all four analytical strategies, outperforming its sector by +11.6% over the past quarter.
